scope: Evidence synthesis for story-critical item identity, inventory, NPC material delivery, DIY recipe gates, crafting transaction, structure/furniture requirements, and tool durability. No Godot/build work or live-game execution.

evidence_labels.EF: Decoded EventFlow graph and ordered action/query references.
evidence_labels.TBL: Resolved 1.0.0 source table row or table join.
evidence_labels.NATIVE: Original native instructions executed in a bounded synthetic/in-memory fixture.
evidence_labels.NATIVE_STATIC: Disassembly/decompiler and indexed call-site trace; native behavior not run in the stated context.
evidence_labels.CAT: Catalogue candidate only; no raw source/runtime binding proof.

claims: ItemParam.UniqueID is the recipe output and ingredient key; RecipeCraftParam.Item joins all 552 outputs uniquely and all 1020 populated material slots join to ItemParam.UniqueID.
RecipeCraftParam row 56 outputs item 975 (FtrFruitbasket) and requires one each of item IDs 2213, 2285, 2287, 2214, and 2286.

The original catch-result insertion path writes an eight-byte item word into a 20-record active inventory view, uses 65534/0xfffe as the empty ID, selects the first empty slot, and on a full view shifts slots 1..19 left before writing at slot 19.
limits: This is result-to-inventory behavior for catch results, not an ordinary ground pickup trace.
Owner lookup, view selection, global empty-item word, and optional normalization use controlled or stubbed fixture data; no player save is mutated.
A/B/C cache groups remain structural labels and are not mapped to named bag/storage save members.
The cache/count helpers do not establish a complete persistent stack-record schema.

claims: Original inventory-cache producers populate item counters through ItemParam validity/normalization and MultiHoldMaxNum/FreeParam readers.
The warm-cache requirement reader was run for 2160 cases; selected normal-item counts aggregate A+B narrowed to u16, with source C controlled by a native option.
Cold-cache recipe-56 checks pass for all five fixture materials with C enabled and fail for the peach material when C is excluded or the peach fixture record is absent.
fixture_limits: Cache source records and player context are reconstructed; no source player save was supplied.
The cold-cache run stubs only SDK memset byte-fill; A/B/C source-member names are unresolved.
Wrapped/remade item branches and the alternative source-count branch remain open.

claims: Prologue flow sets PlayerPickupEnable and gates branches/fruits with HasTargetItem followed by DeleteTargetItem and delivery actions.
TownFruitTypeChk checks and consumes six of the selected native island fruit and then sets HaveTownFruit4CampFire.

Nook's Cranny material flow checks 30 each of wood 2768, hardwood 2769, softwood 2767, and iron nugget 2511; the matching delete entry is followed by its RcmShopMaterial flag and eventual shop-kit reward.
limits: EventFlow order/parameters are proven; DeleteTargetItem and delivery effects were not executed against a player pocket.
World-item pickup, collection animation, and pocket writer are not connected by native evidence.

claims: Day-2 DIY flow requires five branches and teaches DIYtutorial1/DIYtutorial2 before enabling recipe-related progression.
Recipe 458 has WoodBridge unlock and outputs item 7211; recipe 461 has CampSite unlock and outputs item 5166.
Ftr_Working routes cWorkCraft through SaveSetFromUIResult before Making/GetDemo; WorkCraftBgPage is an identified UI factory, not proof of a live commit.
Native recipe-56 getter and material sufficiency path execute on controlled records.
The original transaction branch can route result 975 into a controlled free pocket slot via 0xf987c0 after explicit actor-resolution controls.

bounded_results.material_removal_attempt: 0xeff060 reached the original 0xaac730/0xf9e840/0xf9e410 gate; the fixture was rejected, Apple count stayed 9, no inventory bytes changed, consumption_verified=false.
bounded_results.result_insertion_partial_branch: With explicit no-match registry control, 0xf987c0 inserted output 975 into slot 19 in the 19/20 case and slot 4 after the synthetic full-pocket compaction case.
bounded_results.transaction_mutators_in_branch_probe: 0xeff060/0xee1060 were stubbed; no material balance is proven.

limits: The Apple wrapper fixture supplies an ItemParam row pointer where the original lookup expects a dense ItemParam index; the native gate rejects it.
Full UI item selection, learned-recipe wrapper, successful ingredient removal, transaction atomicity/rollback, and live pocket insertion are not proven.
The result insertion case is a synthetic branch probe and later native fixture execution may fault after pocket mutation; it is not a completed save-backed craft.
SaveProc serialization/write/flush/reload has not been joined to this transaction.

claims: Bridge kit 7211 is gated by recipe 458; placing it sets ImmQ_SetBridge before three housing kits 5827..5829 and further recipe unlocks are issued.
Each plot A/B/C tracks three interior donation flags and an outside-complete query; the daily completion flow checks all four parts for each plot.
All three plots are required for RcmImmQuestComplete; house-count gates then feed Resident Services, campsite/first camper, and island-evaluation story progression.
limits: EventFlow identifies the checklist and item IDs; exact outside-furniture acceptance semantics and real placed-object sets are not reproduced.
Kit-to-world transform, build placement UI and collision instance are not linked in a live world.

claims: All 32 ItemParam tool rows join to ItemOutfitInfo.BreakDamage.
Packed ToolDamage occupies low 10 bits of the halfword at item-word byte offset +6; increment saturates at 999 and remaining wear is BreakDamage minus ToolDamage.
0xe895a0 copies wear to a selected player pocket item and sets slot dirty bit 0x4000; it accepts a further increment after threshold and its success value is not a break indication.
Ring callback indices 0..7 read matching pocket item words in an eight-case native probe; the ring-to-held-hand/equip transition remains open.
limits: Eligibility, ItemParam index/cache, item-view construction and pocket accessors are supplied through bounded stubs/fixtures.
Successful-use state does not prove the zero-remaining state transition; family cadence is incomplete.

story_gates.result: four material flags then shop kit; next-day structure processor opens shop
bridge placement precedes housing kit grant; plot furniture checklist precedes all-three completion
ItemParam output IDs 7211/5166 map back to recipe IDs via DiyRecipeID

gameplay_data.conversion: Preserve source row IDs, raw hashes, descriptors, and exact integer fields in typed JSON.

ui.conversion: BFLYT to pane-tree JSON; BFLAN to section/raw summary; page-to-flow, input and live focus are still partial.

animation.conversion: ASB to state/transition/condition/event JSON; BFLAN treated separately; actor state/clip-to-action bindings remain open.

model.conversion_if_source_is_supplied: Yaz0/SARC to BFRES to GLB plus textures; preserve provenance and note LOD/material fidelity limits.

audio.conversion_if_source_is_supplied: BARS/AMTA to BWAV offsets to PCM WAV to OGG, retaining rate/channel/sample/loop metadata.

text.conversion: MSBT to JSON preserving archive, label, language, tags and source identity; runtime label selection/substitution and playback are partial.

world_data.limits: Story-kit transform, specific island instance and placement flow remain open.

collision.conversion: Keep .phive raw until parser and physics semantics are validated; no exact placement validator/owner join exists.
